text: Patient presented with acute shortness of breath and wheezing. Diagnosed with acute exacerbation of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). Prescribed Albuterol sulfate 90mcg inhaler 2 puffs Q4H PRN for shortness of breath and Prednisone 20mg oral daily for 5 days. Notable allergy to penicillin causing urticaria.
